title: fix(fields): draw the unparsable-date dash through the shared EmptyValue affordance (objectui#8809)
body:
Fixes #8809

The readonly `date` widget faces draw `formatDate`'s em-dash through the shared `EmptyValue` affordance instead of a plain SPAN. **The carrier changes, the glyph does not.**

DOM shapes are written in words throughout — tag-shaped fragments are eaten from GitHub bodies even inside backticks.

## The defect, stated precisely

A truthy value `new Date(...)` cannot read — `not-a-date`, `2024-13-45` — reached `formatDate`, which answers it with its own em-dash, and that dash was painted in a SPAN carrying no `data-slot` of `empty-value` and no accessible name. A screen reader got naked punctuation. Same class as objectui#8475 (`RelatedList`) and objectui#8491 (`ObjectGrid`).

**What was *not* wrong is the glyph.** That dash was not an unnoticed accident: objectui#8194 enumerated the four `formatDate` sites, fed each this same input, and split them 3-1 **on purpose** — `GridField` keeps the raw stored string (objectui#3569, "showing the user what is actually stored beats hiding it"), the other three inherit the shared empty face. That card chose the glyph and pinned it.

## ⭐ The glyph is unchanged — please check this first

`EmptyValue`'s **own default glyph is the em-dash** (`packages/components/src/custom/empty.tsx`, `glyph = "—"`). So the rendered text is byte-identical and only the carrier moves: the dash gains `data-slot` of `empty-value` and an accessible name ("No value", localized — `无` in `zh`).

That is why **objectui#8194's three landed `textContent` assertions stay green**, and it is the whole reason this repair is available to this card at all:

| arm | rendered text | #8194's pin |
|---|---|---|
| this PR (carrier only) | still the em-dash | **green** |
| print the raw value instead | `not-a-date` | **red** |

**#8194's split is preserved, not reopened.** Moving these faces to the raw string would reverse that card's documented, pinned choice for `DateField` and re-split it away from `FormulaField` — a maintainer-level reversal, deliberately not taken here.

## Sites

| # | site | in scope | why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `packages/fields/src/widgets/DateField.tsx` readonly branch | ✅ | its landed pin reads `container.textContent` |
| 2 | `packages/fields/src/widgets/FormulaField.tsx` `return_type: 'date'` | ✅ | same, verified the same way |
| 3 | the `$date` lookup fallback (`lookupColumnDisplay.tsx`) | ⛔ dropped | **measured, not assumed:** its pin reads the function's RETURN VALUE through `String(...)`, not DOM. Returning the affordance makes that read `[object Object]` and turns a landed pin red, and the repair may not be bought by rewriting one. The branch also sits in a documented plain-text fallback whose every other arm returns a string (objectui#5492). |
| 4 | `GridField` | ⛔ out | the other side of the #8194 split; raw is deliberate and pinned twice |

Sites 3 and 4 are pinned in the new file's `SCOPE FENCE`, so a future sweep must move a pin deliberately rather than pass silently.

The guard reproduces `formatDate`'s own parse, so it is **co-extensive with the dash it replaces and never wider**; a parseable value keeps its formatted face and carries no affordance.

## Evidence

**Reverse verification**, per site — mutation proven on disk before any result was read (anchor count 1 then 0, blob hash changed), direction predicted first, restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` and the restore proven (`git diff HEAD` empty **and** blob hash equal to the HEAD blob):

| leg | new pin | #8194 pin | matched prediction |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DateField` guard removed | **exit 1** — 6 failed / 16 passed | **exit 0** — 118 passed | ✅ |
| `FormulaField` guard removed | **exit 1** — 6 failed / 16 passed | **exit 0** — 118 passed | ✅ |

The red cases are exactly `THE REPAIR` (affordance + accessible name); `THE COMPATIBILITY CLAIM` stays green in both legs. **That asymmetry is the finding**: a text-only pin can never catch this defect, which is why the new pin reads the DOM.

**Gates** — each quoting its own verdict line. Build, type-check, test and lint ran at `2a38a49ca`; the only delta to final head `015aa783d` is the added changeset file, and lint was re-run at `015aa783d` with an identical verdict.

| gate | verdict line | exit |
|---|---|---|
| dependency-closure build | `✓ built in 23.68s` (components) | 0 |
| `@object-ui/fields` build | `✓ built in 16.39s` | 0 |
| `type-check` | `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` clean | 0 |
| `test` (whole package) | `Test Files 150 passed (150)` / `Tests 2568 passed (2568)` | 0 |
| `lint` (whole package) | `✖ 959 problems (0 errors, 959 warnings)` | 0 |
| `check-control-bytes` | `✅ check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 7009 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` | 0 |
| `changeset:check` | `✅ No changeset declares a major bump.` | 0 |
| `check-changeset-presence` | `✅ 3 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)` | 0 |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (changed paths) | `✅ NOT GOVERNED — 4 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched.` | 0 |
| ↳ **lit control**, same command shape, `AGENTS.md` | `⛔ GOVERNED — 1 of 1 path(s) are on a governed surface` | 3 |

The lit control is what makes the `NOT GOVERNED` reading a reading rather than a dead check. `type-check` was proven to actually cover the new test file with `tsc --listFiles`, not assumed — all three changed files appear in its file list. The three lint warnings on the two touched widgets sit outside my diff hunks (`git diff -U0` hunk headers confirm it); they are pre-existing.

## 验收备注

Observations found and deliberately not filed or fixed, each with the successor who will meet them:

- **The `$date` lookup fallback draws the same dash in the same defect shape.** Not filed: it is the same decision as this card on the same axis, and its repair is blocked on a contract question about `renderLookupColumnValue`'s return type (element versus text), not on this card's ruling. **Successor:** whoever takes that function's return-type contract; the `SCOPE FENCE` case here is the marker they will hit.
- **`DateTimeField.tsx:19-23`** renders `Invalid Date Invalid Date` rather than a dash — a different failure shape, not this one. **Successor:** objectui#8209, which owns that file.
- **`CurrencyField.tsx:24-47`**'s `Intl`-throw fallback prints a degraded amount rather than the affordance. Not a defect and not a card; recorded because it is the second place in this family where "cannot format" is distinguished from "empty". **Successor:** none — no queued PR or person is heading for that file on this axis.
- **`GridField` is the only readonly widget face that distinguishes "unformattable" from "empty" and prints the raw value.** Measured across all 44 `*Field.tsx` files plus the other 52 `.tsx` files under `widgets/`, with a lit control. Recorded here because it falsified the dispatch's original premise and reshaped this card's ruling. **Successor:** anyone tempted to "converge" it — the `SCOPE FENCE` case and objectui#3569 both say don't.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 两个只读 `date` 面(`DateField` 的只读分支、`FormulaField` 的 `return_type: 'date'` 路径)在遇到无法解析的值时,改为渲染共享的 `EmptyValue`,而不是把 `formatDate` 的破折号画进一个裸 SPAN。新增一个读 DOM 的 pin 文件与一个 changeset。

**为什么改** — 破折号本身没问题,#8194 已经选定并钉住了它;**坏的是载体**:那个破折号没有 `data-slot`、没有可访问名,读屏软件拿到的是一串无名标点(与 objectui#8475 / #8491 同类)。`EmptyValue` 自己的默认字形**就是**同一个破折号,所以本次只换载体,渲染文本一字不变 —— #8194 那三条已落地的断言因此全部保持绿,那条 3-1 的分裂被**保留**而不是被重开。两个站点一起修,是因为 #8194 刚把它们的**字形**收敛掉,只修一个会在**载体**上开出一个新的分裂。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险低。视觉零变化(同一个字形、同一个位置);行为变化只发生在今天已经画破折号的那些值上,守卫复刻了 `formatDate` 自己的解析,与它替换掉的破折号**同外延、绝不更宽**,可解析的值完全不受影响。代价:这两个面对无法解析的值现在向辅助技术自称「无值」,而字段其实存了东西 —— 这正是卡片对臂 1 的原始异议,本 PR 承认它并选择接受,因为替代方案(打印原值)要推翻 #8194 的明确裁决。**回滚**:两处各删一行守卫即可,`git revert` 本 PR 干净,无迁移、无数据、无新导出、无新 prop。

**席位意见** — (留给 PM 席位填写)

**你要做的** — 请重点看两件事:① 表格里那条不对称(本 PR 让 #8194 的 pin 保持绿,打印原值会让它变红)是本次「只修载体」的全部理由,若您认为 `date` 面本就该跟 `GridField` 走原值路线,那是对 #7620 裁决 A 与 #8194 的重裁,应整族一次做完,⛔ 不要从这张卡开口子;② 站点 3(`$date` 回退)被**测量后**排除而非顺手放过,理由写在 `SCOPE FENCE` 里,若您希望一并收敛,请先裁 `renderLookupColumnValue` 的返回类型契约。
